description: Figure: conservation of the structurally defined SpuA glutamate pocket across the KT2440 PuuD-family paralogs
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd
# Data computed in the previous cell (PDB 7D53 pocket mapping)
pos=["G66","S67","P68","S69","N70","C113","R114","Q117","I180","H181","G182","Q183","Q219","H221"]
cols=["PP_2179 spuA","PP_5298","PP_3598","PP_0727","E.coli PuuD","Human GGH"]
vals=[["G","S","P","S","N","C","R","Q","I","H","G","Q","Q","H"],
      ["G","S","P","S","N","C","R","Q","L","H","S","Q","Q","H"],
      ["G","A","G","S","N","C","R","Q","L","H","G","Q","Q","H"],
      ["G","G","G","S","-","C","R","Q","Y","H","E","Y","M","H"],
      ["G","S","P","S","N","C","R","Q","L","H","G","Q","Q","H"],
      ["G","G","S","V","D","C","L","E","L","S","V","K","Q","H"]]
ref=[p[0] for p in pos]
M=np.array([[1 if v==r else (0.5 if v!="-" else 0) for v,r in zip(col,ref)] for col in vals])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,3.6))
im=ax.imshow(M,cmap="RdYlGn",vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect="auto")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(pos))); ax.set_xticklabels(pos,fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_yticklabels(cols,fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(cols)):
    for j in range(len(pos)):
        ax.text(j,i,vals[i][j],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=9,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_title("Glutamate-binding pocket of P. aeruginosa SpuA (PDB 7D53, residues within 4.5 A of bound Glu)\nmapped onto KT2440 paralogs by global alignment. Green = identical to SpuA, yellow = substituted",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("SpuA residue position",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
